summary: Three hosts—Misha (Thailand), Adrian (Mexico), and Edin (Ethiopia)—present a cohesive vegan day drawn from their home cuisines, spanning breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The video pairs practical, hands-on techniques with cultural storytelling: from making fresh soy milk (soaking soybeans, removing skins for a smoother milk, pressing through cheesecloth to yield okara) and infusing pandan, to kneading and proofing a yeast-raised dough for crispy patanko donuts, to plant-based riffs on familiar dishes (Mexican tofu scramble with beans and avocado; Ethiopian fool and berbere-spiked lentils; papaya salad and tofu satay; a Thai-inspired tomka coconut soup; kanekonchila with injera). The presenters model flavor layering (garlic, onions, chilies, turmeric, nutritional yeast, berbere, korarima), dairy-free sauces (coconut milk-based peanut sauce and curries), and technique-driven steps (pounding, simmering, straining, and roasting). Personal memories and regional context—especially Tigrai—wrap the cooking demonstrations in culture, advocacy, and the idea that vegan adaptations can honor traditional foods.

sections.title: Intro and cultural framing
sections.description: Three hosts introduce a vegan day across Thailand, Mexico, and Ethiopia, signaling a cross-cultural, meal-spread approach (breakfast, lunch, dinner).

sections.title: Homemade soy milk prep
sections.description: Bean soaking, optional skin removal for smoother tofu/soy milk, blending with water, and straining through cheesecloth to yield fresh soy milk and the byproduct okara.

sections.title: Dough fermentation and frying (patanko)
sections.description: Yeast activates in warm water with sugar; dough made with bread flour, sugar, salt, baking powder; hand-kneaded, rested 3-4 hours, rolled, cut into rectangles, and fried into fluffy donuts.

sections.title: Mexican breakfast: tofu scramble
sections.description: Tofu scramble: crumbled tofu sautéed with aromatics and spices; moisture balanced with almond milk; served with beans and avocado for a Mexican-style start.

sections.title: Ethiopian breakfast: fool (fava mash)
sections.description: Crushed fava beans paired with onion, cumin, garlic, and tomato; berbere spice builds the flavor profile; lentils cooked with careful water management.

sections.title: Lunch: papaya salad and tofu satay
sections.description: Thai-pounded papaya salad with bright vegetables and lime, paired with marinated tofu satay ready for skewers; peanut sauce components highlighted.

sections.title: Posole rojo (Mexican lunch)
sections.description: Rehydration and blending of dried chiles; vegan broth using bouillon; straining to remove clumps; simmering with hominy for a pozole-style dish.

sections.title: Ethiopian dinner: misir/burssin and lentil base
sections.description: Onions sweated, berbere and tomatoes added, lentils simmered with controlled liquid; served with flatbread; emphasis on flavor layering and vegan adaptation.

sections.title: Thai-inspired tomka coconut soup
sections.description: Herb-forward soup with lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and Thai chilies; mushrooms and tofu in coconut milk; tamarind for sweet-tangy balance; lime finish.

sections.title: Vegan kanekonchila and mushroom tips
sections.description: Veganized konsonchila variant with soy curls marinated and simmered in a chile-tomato base; aromatics and korarima/herbal notes elevate flavors.

sections.title: Mushroom tips and finishing touches
sections.description: Mushrooms sweated, finished with tomato paste and aromatics; served with injera and garnishes for a rich, plant-based finish.

sections.title: Closing reflections
sections.description: Final moment hints at Tigrai and a call to speak up for people there, closing out with music and credits.
